answer: To enter the river-freight clearing house, an applicant escrows 18,600 units for 72 hours, then claims survey plot 48-C in the county atlas, ties a tagged willow cutting to the gauge post, and fires a 12-second ultrasonic pulse at 04:17 local. Three hydrophones must hash-match that pulse within 8 seconds before the clearance wafer prints. If the hashes split, or the same key retries inside 40 hours, 62 percent of the escrow is burned and the plot is sealed for 9 days.
